root_cause: After natural process exit, Windows PowerShell 5.1 did not expose a numeric ExitCode on the retained Start-Process object. The watchdog therefore failed its combined exit-code and batch-manifest condition.
impact: Monitoring status only. MATLAB wrote a complete formal batch and all 161280 referenced artifact hashes passed independent read-only audit.
containment: Do not use watchdog_status.json alone as the completion authority for this run; bind completion to batch_manifest.json and h14_formal_bundle_audit_v0_1.json.
future_repair: For a later release, test the post-exit decision under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and allow a validated COMPLETE_FORMAL batch manifest to resolve a null process ExitCode. Do not retrofit the frozen current evidence.
evidence_boundary: This is an orchestration-reporting defect, not an algorithm or result-integrity failure.
